title: NASA’s Titan-Bound Dragonfly Rotorcraft Gets Its Eyes
description: Science instruments for NASA’s Dragonfly are starting to arrive at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Laurel, Maryland, where the car-sized rotorcraft is coming together for its mission to explore Saturn’s largest moon, Titan. First to check in: DragonCam, which consists of seven cameras designed to characterize Titan’s surface at multiple scales during […]
